sources.note: Homepage. Describes Clinical Navigator as all-in-one EHR + PM for ambulatory practices. Lists key product areas: EHR, Practice Management, Patient Portal, Surgical Pathways, MIPS. Emphasizes one-click navigation and customization.

ONC mandatory disclosures and MIPS solutions page. Lists certification details, version 2024.12, certified 2024-11-26. Shows 20+ clinical quality measures. Includes FHIR API mention and registry reporting capabilities.
EHR solutions page. Describes AI Office Visit, Touch Orders, medication management with PDMP, drug interaction checking, patient tracking, physician dashboards, and customizable workflows.
Practice management page. Covers scheduling, patient registration, AI coding, claims worksheet, automated claim submission, remittance auto-posting, statement batching, and financial dashboards.
Patient portal page. Describes patient self-registration, appointment requests, medication refill requests, secure messaging, online bill pay, and clinical summary access.

Interfaces page. Lists HL7 2.x integrations with labs (LabCorp, Quest, hospital labs), PT systems (WebPT), DME (MotionMD), dictation (Nuance), imaging (Aspyra, RadInfo), and others (Clearwave, Relatient, Surgimate).
Surgical Pathways module page. Describes AI-driven surgical billing, rogue surgery detection, automated CPT coding, task management, patient text messaging, and analytics dashboards.
API registration portal. Describes OAuth 2.0 FHIR API through 'Systemedx XNet'. Supports standalone, EHR launch, and bulk data app types.
EHI export page. Quick reference only — describes CDAEXPORT job stream with options for all/selected/single patient export. Outputs CDA XML, PDFs, and HTML files organized by patient folders.

Birmingham Medical News article about Surgical Pathways. Describes deployment at 43-physician orthopedic/sports medicine practice finding 270 unbilled surgeries/month ($12M revenue). CEO Kevin Bonner created the product. ~80% CPT auto-fill accuracy.
Slashdot/SourceForge listing. Zero user reviews. Lists basic features: customizable workflows, telehealth, HIPAA compliance, ONC certification. No meaningful user feedback available.
RocketReach company profile. Indicates ~$6M revenue, 15 employees. Founded 1997. Originally a document management company that pivoted to healthcare IT.
ZoomInfo listing. Company overview for Systemedx Inc.
Cullman Chamber of Commerce listing. Confirms Cullman, Alabama location.
Software Advice listing. Minimal information — one user mentioned choosing Systemedx for pricing and familiarity from previous practice, and praised customer support.
